title: 3.1beta Watchface isnt connecting.
symptom: After updating to 3.1beta on a Galaxy Watch4, no watchface is connecting. Pressing 'send values to watch' does nothing, and the AAPS complications show '!err!'. The user deleted the old wear apk before installing the new one.
evidence_quote: I'm using a GalaxyWatch4 series and updated to the 3.1beta. No watchface is connecting. Even if I press send values to watch again nothing happens. The aaps complictaions showing !err!
